description: Enhanced Options Explorer: Extend the basic options chain with filtering, IV analysis, near-the-money focus, and volume/OI highlighting. Builds on Feature 8 foundation to provide practical options analysis tools.
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
Build on Feature 8 foundation - extend existing OptionsChainPanel
Apply learnings from Feature 8 user feedback before implementing
Keep calculations local - no external API dependencies for IV analysis

CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.warning: READ THIS BEFORE ANY WIDGET/RENDERING WORK
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.textual_colors: Textual uses Rich markup, NOT ANSI escape codes!
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.iv_colors: Low IV: [green], Medium IV: [yellow], High IV: [red]

feature8Foundation: Options service with fetch_option_expirations() and fetch_option_chain()
j/k navigation, [ ] expiration cycling, c/p calls/puts toggle

enhancementsOverview.filtering: Filter by ITM/OTM/All to focus on relevant strikes
enhancementsOverview.nearMoney: Auto-focus on strikes near current stock price
enhancementsOverview.ivAnalysis: Color-code IV to identify expensive/cheap options
enhancementsOverview.volumeHighlighting: Highlight high-volume contracts showing institutional interest

ivAnalysisConcepts.iv_rank: Where current IV sits relative to past year (0-100%)
ivAnalysisConcepts.iv_percentile: Percentage of days IV was lower than current
ivAnalysisConcepts.interpretation: High IV = expensive options (good for selling), Low IV = cheap options (good for buying)

feature8Learnings.CRITICAL_READ_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTING: These learnings from Feature 8 MUST be applied to avoid bugs and rework

nanHandling.issue: Options data has many NaN values - IV, volume, and OI can all be NaN/None
nanHandling.pattern: Use math.isnan() after float conversion - cannot convert NaN to int directly
nanHandling.implementation: Create safe_float() and safe_int() helper functions for ALL numeric conversions
nanHandling.testCase: Always test with contracts that have NaN IV, zero volume, zero OI

widgetStateMachine.concern: VPR-086 adds summary_mode - decide if this is a 5th state or orthogonal boolean
widgetStateMachine.recommendation: Keep as orthogonal boolean (_summary_mode: bool) since summary can have its own loading/error states
widgetStateMachine.guardConditions: Always check state before actions - don't filter/jump if in loading/error state

priorityBindings.pattern: Panel keybindings use priority=True to intercept before app-level bindings
priorityBindings.implementation: Add to BINDINGS list with Binding(..., priority=True)

selectionResetPattern.newTrigger: ATM jump should SET selection to ATM row index, not reset to 0

noRefetchForViewChanges.principle: Both calls and puts already loaded from single API call
noRefetchForViewChanges.exception: Summary view (VPR-086) MAY need to fetch multiple chains - cache aggressively

testPatterns.stateLogicTests: Test state logic directly without mounting widget (avoids async complexity)
testPatterns.attributeSetting: Use direct attribute setting for state transitions in tests
testPatterns.pureLogicTests: ATM finding, IV color thresholds, volume averages are pure functions - test independently

ivMayBeNaN.solution: Filter out NaN IVs before min/max calculation, return default color for NaN
ivMayBeNaN.testCase: Test chain where some contracts have NaN IV

volumeOiMayBeZero.scenario: All contracts have zero volume or zero OI
volumeOiMayBeZero.solution: If avg is 0, skip highlighting (nothing is 'high' relative to zero)
volumeOiMayBeZero.testCase: Test chain with all zero volumes

atmWithNoCurrentPrice.solution: Graceful degradation - skip ATM features, show all strikes without highlight
atmWithNoCurrentPrice.testCase: Test options panel when _current_price is None

summaryViewMultipleChains.scenario: Summary view needs data from 8 expirations
concerns: Need loading state per expiration or global
summaryViewMultipleChains.solution: Show loading indicator, fetch chains in parallel, cache results
summaryViewMultipleChains.testCase: Test summary view with slow/failed chain fetches

filterAndAtmInteraction.scenario: ATM strike is OTM, user applies ITM filter, presses 'a' to jump to ATM
options: Option A: 'a' key temporarily shows ATM even if filtered out (confusing)
Option B: 'a' key does nothing if ATM not in filtered list (show message)
Option C: 'a' key clears filter first, then jumps (implicit filter change)
filterAndAtmInteraction.recommendation: Option B - show 'ATM strike not visible with current filter' message
filterAndAtmInteraction.testCase: Test 'a' key when ATM strike is filtered out

emptyFilterResults.scenario: Filter results in zero contracts (e.g., all contracts are OTM, user filters ITM)
emptyFilterResults.solution: Show 'No contracts match filter' message, disable j/k navigation
emptyFilterResults.testCase: Test ITM filter when all contracts are OTM

sameIvAllContracts.scenario: All contracts have identical IV (edge case)
sameIvAllContracts.solution: If max_iv == min_iv, all contracts get medium (yellow) color
sameIvAllContracts.testCase: Test chain where all IVs are 0.25

ivRankDivisionByZero.scenario: max_iv == min_iv when calculating IV rank
ivRankDivisionByZero.solution: Return 50% (middle) or N/A when range is zero
ivRankDivisionByZero.testCase: Test IV rank with identical min/max IV

userStories.title: Add filter mode - ITM/OTM/All

Filter mode shown in header: 'OPTIONS: AAPL | 2024-03-15 | CALLS | Filter: All'
ITM filter: only show contracts where in_the_money == True
OTM filter: only show contracts where in_the_money == False
All filter: show all contracts (default)
Filter applies to currently displayed list (calls or puts)
Reset selected row to 0 when filter changes
Handle edge case: filter results in empty list (show 'No contracts match filter')
Store _filter_mode: str = 'all' in panel
100% test coverage on filter logic
Test: filter cycles correctly All -> ITM -> OTM -> All
Test: empty filter results handled gracefully
Update help_screen.py with 'f' keybinding
userStories.notes: Simple filter on existing data. No refetch needed. Filter icon or text in header shows current mode.

userStories.title: Near-the-money focus
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate ATM strike: closest strike to current stock price
Add method: _find_atm_strike(contracts, current_price) -> float
On panel load: auto-scroll to show ATM strike in center of view
ATM strike row highlighted differently (e.g., [cyan] text or border)
Show +/- N strikes from ATM when filtering (e.g., ATM +/- 5 strikes)
Add 'a' keybinding: jump to ATM strike
Store current stock price when loading options (from existing quote)
If current price unavailable, skip ATM highlighting (graceful degradation)
100% test coverage on ATM calculation and highlighting
Test: ATM strike correctly identified for various price scenarios
Update help_screen.py with 'a' keybinding
userStories.notes: ATM focus helps users quickly find relevant strikes. Need to pass current stock price to options panel - can get from existing quote service.

userStories.title: IV color coding
acceptanceCriteria: Color-code IV column based on value relative to range in current chain
Calculate IV range: min_iv and max_iv from all contracts in current expiration
Low IV (bottom third): [green] - options are relatively cheap
Medium IV (middle third): [yellow] - normal pricing
High IV (top third): [red] - options are relatively expensive
Add method: _get_iv_color(iv, min_iv, max_iv) -> str
Recalculate ranges when expiration changes
Handle edge case: all IVs same (no coloring needed)
100% test coverage on IV color logic
Test: correct colors assigned for various IV distributions
Visual test: verify colors render correctly in terminal
userStories.notes: Relative coloring within current chain. Not absolute IV rank (that requires historical data). Simple but effective visual cue.

userStories.title: Volume and OI highlighting
acceptanceCriteria: Identify high-volume contracts: volume > 2x average volume in chain
Identify high-OI contracts: open_interest > 2x average OI in chain
Highlight high-volume contracts with [bold] text style
Highlight high-OI contracts with different indicator (e.g., * prefix)
Calculate averages when chain loads: avg_volume and avg_oi
Add method: _is_high_volume(volume, avg_volume) -> bool
Add method: _is_high_oi(oi, avg_oi) -> bool
Handle edge case: all volumes zero (no highlighting)
100% test coverage on highlighting logic
Test: correct contracts highlighted for various volume distributions
userStories.notes: High volume/OI indicates institutional interest or popular strikes. Simple 2x threshold is a reasonable heuristic.

userStories.title: Multi-expiration summary view
acceptanceCriteria: Add 's' keybinding: toggle summary view mode
Summary view shows ATM strike for each expiration (condensed)
j/k navigation moves between expirations in summary view
Enter on expiration: switch to that expiration's full chain view
Show up to 8 nearest expirations in summary
Store _summary_mode: bool = False in panel
Summary mode and full mode are mutually exclusive states
100% test coverage on summary view logic
Test: summary view shows correct ATM data for each expiration
Test: Enter on summary row switches to full view
Update help_screen.py with 's' keybinding
userStories.notes: Quick overview of multiple expirations without navigating one by one. Shows ATM call/put bid-ask and IV at a glance.

userStories.title: IV rank calculation (simplified)
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate simplified IV rank using current chain data only
IV rank = (current_atm_iv - min_iv) / (max_iv - min_iv) * 100
Display IV rank in panel header: 'IV Rank: 45%'
Color IV rank: < 30% green (low), 30-70% yellow (normal), > 70% red (high)
Note: This is NOT true historical IV rank (which requires 52-week IV data)
Add tooltip or help text explaining this is relative IV rank
Store _iv_rank: float | None in panel
Update IV rank when expiration changes
Handle edge case: no ATM strike or no IV data (show 'N/A')
100% test coverage on IV rank calculation
Test: correct rank for various IV distributions
userStories.notes: True IV rank requires historical IV data (not available in yfinance). This simplified version compares current ATM IV to IV range in current chain - still useful for relative assessment.

filterImplementation.persistence: Filter resets to 'all' when ticker changes

atmCalculation.method: Find strike with minimum abs(strike - current_price)
atmCalculation.current_price: Get from QuotePanel or fetch via stock service
atmCalculation.scroll_to_atm: Calculate ATM row index, scroll VerticalScroll to center it

ivColorLogic.calculate_bounds: min_iv = min([c.iv for c in contracts]), max_iv = max([c.iv for c in contracts])
ivColorLogic.third_calculation: low_threshold = min_iv + (max_iv - min_iv) / 3, high_threshold = min_iv + 2 * (max_iv - min_iv) / 3
ivColorLogic.color_assignment: iv < low_threshold: green, iv < high_threshold: yellow, else: red

volumeOiHighlighting.styling: Use Rich markup: [bold]{value}[/bold] for high volume
volumeOiHighlighting.indicator: Add * or marker for high OI

summaryViewDesign.layout: One row per expiration, showing ATM call/put at a glance
summaryViewDesign.data_needed: For each expiration: date, ATM call bid/ask, ATM put bid/ask, ATM IV
summaryViewDesign.fetching: Fetch all chains on summary load (may be slow - show loading)
summaryViewDesign.caching: Cache chain data to avoid refetching when switching views

ivRankCalculation.atm_iv: IV of the ATM strike (or average of ATM call + put IV)
ivRankCalculation.limitations: Not true 52-week IV rank - just relative to current chain
ivRankCalculation.documentation: Make clear in help text this is simplified IV rank

testingStrategy: Unit tests: all calculation methods (ATM, IV color, volume threshold, IV rank)
Widget tests: filter cycling, summary view toggle, highlighting
Integration tests: full workflow with filtering, navigation, view modes
Edge cases: empty chains, all same IV, all zero volume, no ATM
filesToModify: viper/widgets/help_screen.py - document new keybindings (f, a, s)
viper/app.py - may need to pass current price to options panel

outOfScope: Greeks calculation (delta, theta, gamma, vega) - requires Black-Scholes + scipy
True historical IV rank (52-week) - requires historical IV data not in yfinance
Payoff diagrams - requires matplotlib or custom charting
Options trading/order entry - out of scope entirely
successMetrics: Summary view shows all expirations at a glance
Enter on summary row navigates to full view
IV rank displays in header with color
All new features work with existing j/k/[ ]/c/p navigation
